_comment: Chapter 4 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F20, a scene: the mural of the Godborn and the Buried Ones against the old god.

text.zh_TW: 牆上有一幅巨大的壁畫：一群手掌發光的人，站在石龍和巨像中間，一起擋住從天上伸下來的黑手。最前面的那個人，個子很小。
text.en: A huge mural covers the wall: people with glowing palms stand among stone dragons and giants, holding back a black hand reaching down from the sky. The one at the very front is small.
